Basketball in Copenhagen for English-speaking families

Talata is a basketball club on Østerbro in Copenhagen. We coach in English and Danish.

Ages
From 5. Mini and Junior 5 to 12, Sparks girls 6 to 14, Academy 13 to 19, Men 18 and up
Where
Mostly Østerbro: Svanemøllehallen and Strandvejsskolen. Every hall
Price
Mini and Junior 1.800 kr, Academy 3.300 kr, Men 2.000 kr, per half-season
First session
Free
Book a trial

Who comes to Talata

About a third of our players come from international families. The rest are Danish families from around Copenhagen, and everyone trains together.

Coach Deng played college basketball in Canada and then professionally in Canada, Lithuania and Denmark. Our camps go to Canada and Lithuania too, so the club is used to people arriving from somewhere else.

Signing up, in English

Every step on our side is in English. The one Danish part is Holdsport, the team app, and we walk you through it.

  1. Book a trial on the join page. It takes 30 seconds, and you see your day, time and hall straight away.
  2. Come along. Indoor trainers and a water bottle. We bring the balls.
  3. If it is a fit, join on Holdsport. Holdsport is in Danish. Log på means log in and Opret ny profil means create a new profile. Make the profile in the player’s name, then add the parents. We send you the link.
  4. Sign up for each session in Holdsport, and cancel there when you cannot come. Our Holdsport guide in English shows which buttons to press, payments included.

International school families

Students at ISH, the International School of Hellerup, train with our U15 and U17 on Thursdays at Svanemøllehallen. ISH High School basketball has the details.

We also work with schools. Our coaches come to the school, collect the children and run the session. See our school partnerships, with Strandvejsskolen and ISH.

Groups and times

  • Mini, ages 5 to 9: Tue + Thu 15:30 to 16:30 at Strandvejsskolen, Sat 10:00 to 11:00 at Kulturhuset Indre By
  • Junior, ages 10 to 12: Tue + Thu 16:30 to 18:00 at Strandvejsskolen, Sat 11:00 to 12:00 at Kulturhuset Indre By
  • Sparks, girls 6 to 14: Mon 15:30 to 16:30 at Strandvejsskolen
  • Academy, ages 13 to 19: up to five days a week, Monday to Friday. See the week
  • Talata Men, 18 and up: Mon 18:45 to 20:15 at Svanemøllehallen, Fri 18:45 to 21:00 at Nørre Fælled Skole from 23 Oct

Every fee and age group is on the prices and times page.

Questions

Can my child start mid-season?

Yes, any time of year. Basketball in Copenhagen covers seasons and fees.

What should we bring the first time?

Indoor trainers and a water bottle. Your first session explains the rest.
